protection_mask: baseline prediction correct and confidence >= 0.8; train only

upstream_research_proxy.purpose: strictly evaluate the conditional-correction mechanism without reusing a target-trained upstream checkpoint
upstream_research_proxy.visual_encoder: fixed PKU-MMD external R(2+1)D-34 encoder; fixed Kinetics normalization; 512-D features
upstream_research_proxy.temporal_encoder: fixed NTU external DSTFormer skeleton encoder; native supplied skeleton resampled only to the source encoder's 64-frame contract
upstream_research_proxy.target_heads: independent LayerNorm+Linear 40-class heads, 60 fixed epochs, AdamW lr=0.003, weight_decay=0.01, label_smoothing=0.02
upstream_research_proxy.inner_folds: the four remaining predefined subject groups within each outer-train split
upstream_research_proxy.outer_held_upstream: separate heads fitted on all outer-train users and evaluated once on outer-held users
upstream_research_proxy.baseline_fusion: frozen outer strictV3 temperatures and T/V gate weights, Fusion=0, visual_package_output_scale=0.5
upstream_research_proxy.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch; no held labels

current_status: upstream protocol locked before feature extraction or scoring
